lesson.title: 4.3 Where Things Are
lesson.unit_outcome: Say where people and things are at home, describe a short daily routine, ask and answer Do you...? questions, and say the day and the time.
lesson.goal: Understand and use in, on, under and next to, and answer Where is the ...? about known things.
lesson.grammar_function: Where is the + named object? The named object is in/on/under/next to the + known noun.
lesson.prerequisite: 4.1-4.2 rooms and home objects; 2.3 objects; 3.7 where.
lesson.speaking_outcome: Ask where a named object is and describe its location, reusing known object names and blue.
